page.overview:
Who is Hotwire?

{| class="wikitable" style="border-collapse:collapse;" !style="border:1px solid black" colspan=2|Generation 2

Hotwire was available bagged with Hotwire's Mech exclusively at the 2008 International G.I. Convention in Dallas, TX. ---- Appearance: brown hair; white lab coat with red Cobra logos; blue pants, black belt, gloves, and boots

Accessories: grey grenade launcher and blowtorch; clear display stand ---- [http://www.yojoe.com/action/08/hotwire.shtml YoJoe.com page]/[http://www.yojoe.com/filecard/08/hotwire.shtml Filecard]
